methodology.discovery: GitHub connector repository search by generative-AI and creative-coding topics, followed by official GitHub REST repository metadata and star-sorted topic searches.
methodology.ranking: Star counts are live popularity snapshots. Ranks are only within these 41 reviewed candidates, not a global ranking of GitHub or a claim of highest quality.
methodology.selection: Prioritize direct fit to HCI/AI, computational space, digital culture/play, and research workflows; prefer active upstream projects; use stars to compare popularity; limit redundant implementations.
methodology.ratings: GitHub supplies stars and forks, not a universal repository-quality rating. No invented score is assigned.
methodology.historical_dates: This search and these study plans were prepared on 2026-10-27. They are not evidence that these projects existed, were used, or were forked by the user in 2022–2025.
methodology.license_caveat: Selected n8n has NOASSERTION in GitHub SPDX metadata. It is included as a high-star public source project, without claiming an unrestricted open-source license. Other candidates retain their own license metadata.
methodology.existing_check: Compared selected names against the 69-repository public account snapshot; all 16 names were absent. The parent should verify actual fork-parent identity before mutation.
